  "title": "Fleet Head of Department (Fleet HOD)",
  "description": "Ascentech Services Limited is a human resources solutions company dedicated to helping businesses build stronger teams and manage people functions more effectively. Established in Nigeria in 2013, we have supported organizations for years with high-quality, practical HR services designed to meet real business needs; adapting to evolving workforce demands and enabling long-term growth. With a strong presence in Lagos and Ibadan, and an expanding footprint through Ascentforce in India, we deliver a broader, more connected approach to recruitment, outsourcing, training, and ongoing HR support.&nbsp;

We are&nbsp;&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:
&nbsp;Job Position: Fleet Head of Department (Fleet HOD)

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary


	We are seeking an experienced and strategic Fleet Head of Department to lead and manage our entire fleet operations.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing vehicle acquisition, maintenance, driver management, compliance, cost control, and operational efficiency across the organization.
	This is a senior leadership role requiring a hands-on professional with a proven track record of optimizing fleet performance, reducing costs, and ensuring safety and regulatory compliance.


Key Responsibilities
Fleet Strategy &amp; Operations Management:


	Develop and implement fleet strategies, policies, and procedures to optimize vehicle utilization, reliability, and efficiency.
	Oversee daily fleet operations, including vehicle deployment, routing, scheduling, and logistics coordination.
	Ensure timely delivery of goods, services, or personnel in line with organizational objectives.


Vehicle Maintenance &amp; Asset Management:


	Establish and manage preventive and corrective maintenance programs to minimize vehicle downtime and extend asset lifespan.
	Oversee vehicle inspections, servicing, repairs, and warranty management.
	Maintain accurate records of vehicle history, mileage, fuel consumption, and maintenance costs.


Driver &amp; Staff Management:


	Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate drivers, mechanics, and fleet support staff.
	Implement driver performance monitoring systems, including telematics and GPS tracking.
	Promote safe driving practices and conduct regular driver training and refresher courses.


Compliance &amp; Regulatory Adherence:


	Ensure all fleet vehicles are roadworthy, properly insured, and fully documented (vehicle registration, licenses, permits, etc.).
	Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations, including FRSC, NTSB, DOT, and local traffic laws.
	Manage accident reporting, investigation, and claims processes.


Budgeting &amp; Cost Control:


	Prepare and manage the fleet budget, including fuel, maintenance, insurance, and procurement costs.
	Implement cost-saving initiatives, such as fuel efficiency programs, route optimization, and vendor negotiations.
	Monitor and report on fleet financial performance, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions.


Procurement &amp; Disposal:


	Manage the acquisition, leasing, or disposal of vehicles, ensuring cost-effectiveness and alignment with operational needs.
	Negotiate with vendors, suppliers, and OEMs for competitive pricing on vehicles, parts, and services.
	Ensure timely replacement of ageing or high-maintenance vehicles.


Technology &amp; Data Management:


	Oversee the implementation and management of fleet management software, GPS tracking, and telematics systems.
	Leverage data analytics to monitor driver behavior, fuel consumption, maintenance trends, and overall fleet performance.
	Prepare and present detailed fleet performance reports to senior management and stakeholders.


Health, Safety &amp; Environment (HSE):


	Enforce strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental standards across all fleet operations.
	Conduct risk assessments and implement safety protocols to reduce accidents and liabilities.
	Ensure all vehicles meet environmental emissions standards.


Candidate Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
	Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in fleet management, logistics, or transport operations, with at least 4 years in a senior management or leadership capacity.
	Proven track record of managing large and diverse vehicle fleets (e.g., trucks, buses, heavy equipment, or light vehicles).
	Master&#39;s degree (MBA or MSc in relevant field) is an added advantage.
	Professional certifications such as CILT (Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport), CPFP (Certified Professional Fleet Manager), or equivalent are highly desirable.
	Strong knowledge of fleet management software, GPS tracking systems, and telematics.
	Proficiency in MS Office Suite, particularly Excel for data analysis and reporting.
	Understanding of vehicle mechanics, maintenance practices, and lifecycle cost analysis.
	Knowledge of Nigerian regulatory frameworks (FRSC, NTSB, etc.).
	Strong leadership, team management, and people development skills.
	Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
	Outstanding communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
	Valid driver&#39;s license.
	Willingness to travel as required.
	Must reside in or be willing to relocate to the specified location.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their CV and relevant certifications to: cv@ascentech.com.ng Using the Job title as the subject of the mail.

  "description": "At Estrada International Staffing Solutions (EISS), we are committed to delivering innovative and impactful human resource solutions that empower organizations and individuals worldwide. By combining global expertise with local insight, we ensure compliance, inclusivity, and sustainable workforce practices across diverse markets.

Our mission is to build trust, drive growth, and shape the future of work by consistently championing excellence in Human Capital Solutions.&nbsp;

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Digital Marketing Analyst (Senior Associate - Senior Consultant)

Job Location: Surulere, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview


	We are looking for an aggressive, data-obsessed Digital Marketer who lives and breathes lead generation, conversion optimization, and multi-channel campaign ROI.
	This is not a role for a generic social media manager; we need a growth-engine driver who understands how to turn digital impressions into qualified B2B corporate leads and measurable revenue.
	You will own the end-to-end performance marketing ecosystem&mdash;from running high-converting Google Ads and managing technical SEO to building omni-channel acquisition funnels (LinkedIn, Email, Meta, Search).
	You will work hand-in-hand with the Business Development team to ensure that every campaign fuels our pipeline with high-ticket enterprise prospects. If you are a master of campaign management, funnel mechanics, and web analytics, your seat is ready.


What you&rsquo;ll drive


	Design, launch, and manage end-to-end B2B lead generation campaigns that convert passive traffic into qualified sales inquiries for all EISS product lines.
	Build cohesive user journeys across Search (Google Ads), Social (LinkedIn Ads, Meta), Email Automation, and Direct Channels to nurture leads from cold awareness to booking a discovery meeting.
	Conduct continuous A/B tests of landing pages, ad copy, CTAs, and opt-in forms to minimize Cost Per Lead (CPL) and maximize Lead-to-Meeting conversion rates
	Manage and optimize paid search campaigns on Google Ads, ensuring aggressive targeting for high-intent B2B keywords while optimizing ad spend efficiency.
	Own Estrada&rsquo;s organic visibility. Conduct keyword research, execute on-page/off-page SEO strategies, and fix technical site issues to rank EISS on Page 1 for high-value corporate HR terms.
	Plan, execute, and monitor multi-channel digital campaigns from initial brief to final ROI reporting.


The ideal fit


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree (B.Sc.) in Marketing, Computer&nbsp;Science, Mass Communication, or a related field.
	Minimum of 3 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with a proven history of generating B2B corporate leads.
	Deep knowledge of omni-channel marketing management.
	Proven experience in video editing, event management, public speaking, content management and campaign management.
	Advanced proficiency in Google Ads, Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and email automation platforms.


Key Skills:


	SEO, omnichannel marketing, lead generation, social media management, follower growth and engagement, content strategy and calendar development, event marketing, marketing CRM management, campaign management, performance marketing, video editing, marketing strategy development and execution, public speaking, and corporate partnerships.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: talents@estradaintl.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

Executive Assistant to the MD Job at Colossus Investment Limited




        
    

        
        Colossus Investment Limited is a private limited company incorporated by the corporate affairs commission (CAC) with registration number 229932 in August 1993 with main business in exportation of agricultural commodities such as sesame, cocoa beans, raw cashew nuts and sales of agricultural processing machinery.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Executive Assistant to the MD 

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Managing Director

Role Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a smart, highly organised, resourceful and confident Executive Assistant to provide direct support to the Managing Director.
	The ideal candidate must be able to manage executive responsibilities independently, communicate effectively, think on their feet and bring strong writing, presentation, social media and creative skills to the role.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage the MD’s calendar, meetings, appointments and daily schedule.
	Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed action points.
	Prepare presentations, reports, briefs, speeches, letters and other executive documents.
	Assist with research, correspondence, write-ups and other assignments from the MD.
	Support the MD’s social media activities and develop engaging, relevant and creative content.
	Assist with public engagements, presentations, meetings and other executive activities.
	Coordinate and follow up on tasks assigned by the MD across relevant departments.
	Maintain confidentiality of executive information and sensitive company matters.
	Handle other administrative and special assignments as required by the MD.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree / HND in any field.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant to a top executive/senior executive.
	Must have completed NYSC.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong public speaking and presentation skills.
	Ability to draft speeches, professional write-ups, correspondence and executive communications.
	Strong social media skills with a good understanding of trends, content, engagement and audience behaviour.
	Creative, confident and capable of developing content and ideas that attract attention.
	Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
	Smart, proactive, presentable and highly resourceful.
	Must be able to think independently, take initiative and deliver quality work without relying solely on AI or automated tools.
	Ability to handle multiple assignments, meet deadlines and work with minimal supervision.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office, PowerPoint and other relevant digital tools.
	High level of discretion and ability to handle confidential information.
	Must be willing to work onsite in Ikeja, Lagos.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT TO THE MD" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only candidates who meet the stated requirements will be considered.
